svg.title: Cozy Reading Nook — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A clearly recognizable sleeping cat curled on a cushioned chair beside a lamp, books, and a moonlit window. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
